She smiles and talks directly to the camera with high energy. (2) A man wearing glasses and a black tank top is introduced; he looks towards the camera with a confused expression as the woman shows him the slippers. The setting is a living room with a computer desk. (3) A small child briefly appears in the frame, holding one of the slippers. The woman explains the purchase while the man remains skeptical in the background. (4) The couple puts on the slippers and attempts to stand. Their faces immediately contort with expressions of intense physical pain and discomfort. The woman wears a grey sweatshirt and shorts, while the man is in a black tank top and shorts. (5) They attempt to walk down a white hallway together, holding hands for support. Their gait is jerky and slow, accompanied by exaggerated movements showing distress. Large variety text overlays in Chinese appear on the screen. (6) The man looks exhausted and continues to show signs of pain while the woman laughs. They conclude the walk by hugging, with the man looking directly at the camera with a look of pained resignation.

The environment sounds like a quiet indoor room. (2) Rustling sounds of plastic packaging are heard as the woman unboxes the slippers. The man's voice enters with a moderate, curious tone, asking questions. (3) Sudden, loud, high-pitched vocalizations of pain and sharp 'Ah!' screams from both the man and woman occur as they step into the slippers. A comedic 'ding' and cartoon-style sound effects emphasize their pained reactions. (4) The BGM abruptly shifts to a slow-tempo, sentimental orchestral piece with soft piano and strings while the woman speaks melodically about the future. This is quickly followed by more intense screams and laughter as they continue walking. (5) The audio track ends with the man's voice sounding strained and breathless, asking about the price, followed by further outbursts of pained groaning and the woman's laughter.
